worked_solution:
Factoring the constant out of the integral, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{3}5{e}^{x}\,\text{d}x & =5{\int }_{0}^{3}{e}^{x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =5\cdot {e}^{x}\,{|}_{0}^{3} \\  & =5({e}^{3}-{e}^{0}) \\  & =5({e}^{3}-1).\end{aligned}
$$
